levels.name: Counting quarter notes
levels.teach: A measure is the space between two bar lines. In 4/4 each measure holds four beats — count 1 2 3 4, then start again.

ex.title: The C Song
ex.instructions: (Right hand only) - Follow along with your eyes as you play. When I say "stop", point to the last note you played.
